overview: The corpus for this packet is entirely 'Tab' keyword noise across 2087 lines, with zero references to the packet, its wrapper, or its header and footer fields. The noise splits into tab-complete (C14) processing (Grim ChatA and CrashH, FlopAC WrappedInTabComplete, Artemis TabComplete packet wrappers and registrations, BetterAnticheat ImpossibleCompletionCheck, Photon TabCompleteSupplier), tab-list rendering (Shard TabListOutput, intave TablistMutator for fake players), command tab-completion handlers (NCP commands, Photon InternalCommand, Rammelkast and AntiCheatPlus config tables), and math table code (Hydro ApacheMath and SensitivityTable, intave's ASM library). The packet is pure presentation with no reply and no timing value, so no anticheat measures it.
